title: Orb Stuff
description: The Orb Mod adds Orb and some other Orb-related stuff
body: The Orb Mod adds Orb, from YouTube, and other Orb-related things, such as orbium, which is necessary to craft the Orb Spawn Egg. The Orbs follow and eat bread and croissants. They also follow the orb plushie and eat physical hay bales. You can craft orbium blocks with orbium too.
